**Troom Troom** is a multinational[1] YouTube channel often cited as being based in Ukraine.[2] It is most known for its life hack, D.I.Y, and prank content. Their videos have received criticism from both news publications and YouTubers for their bizarre nature alongside their usage of "clickbait titles," and are widely parodied, especially on YouTube.[1][3] As of 2023, the channel has over 23 million subscribers and 9 billion views, putting it in the Top 200 most subscribed channels.[4]




## History

[edit]

Troom Troom's YouTube channel was created in 2015. It did not begin with its current style and is noted to have started as a tame attempt at D.I.Y tutorials.[1][5] Not much else is known about Troom Troom's origins or ownership, although it is monetized.[2][3]



## Format & style

[edit]

Troom Troom videos are known for having a distinct style.[2] The videos are brightly coloured and include many sound effects.[2][3] The videos have vibrant thumbnails as well.[6] Another distinction is that most of the characters are not given real names, instead bearing monikers such as "Dolly" and "Redhead".[1][2][5] Its genre of DIY content makes it comparable to channels such as 5-Minute Crafts.[2]



## Reception

[edit]

Troom Troom videos are widely reacted to and criticized on YouTube, and are viewed as being responsible for the rising popularity of many YouTubers such as Danny Gonzalez and Jarvis Johnson.[2][7] The videos sometimes receive questioning for their narration, which is criticized for sounding unnatural.[1][2] In addition, some consider the videos to be unsuitable for children, and to be encouraging dangerous behavior.[3] Troom Troom videos are sometimes considered to be "content farms" for their vibrant thumbnails and "clickbait titles".[2][3][6] Although Troom Troom's videos are popular with their target audience and often go viral, they are generally negatively received by others.[1][5] The channel has over 22 million subscribers and over 9 billion views, making it one of the most popular on the platform.[4]
